dedupe_keys.name: surface deformation time series for ten surface mining complexes sentinel 1 sbas insar pre and post failure

description: This dataset holds Sentinel-1 SBAS-InSAR surface deformation time series for ten surface mining complexes that experienced slope failures. The Zenodo record says it includes cumulative line-of-sight displacement and pre- and post-failure velocity estimates, and supports the paper Monitoring Pre- and Post-Failure InSAR-Derived Deformation in Surface Mining Complexes by Wang and others, under review at the time. It was published in February 2026 by a research team that includes David Petley under the CC BY 4.0 licence, free to download as one zip of about 221 MB. Coverage is ten mine sites whose names and countries are not stated on the page read. Caveats: line-of-sight measurements only, file formats are not stated, and the method details are in the paper. For simulation it gives observed precursor deformation before mine slope failures to calibrate early warning thresholds and geotechnical hazard models for mines and tailings. Related catalogue records include the tailings dam breach runout characteristics and the global database of tailings flows.
name: Surface deformation time series for ten surface mining complexes (Sentinel-1 SBAS-InSAR, pre- and post-failure)
